nativeEffects.name: Radial Blur (Spin)
nativeEffects.description: Applies a radial spin blur around an adjustable center.

nativeEffects.name: Color Curves
nativeEffects.description: Adjusts composite and RGB channels with a direct-manipulation curve editor.

nativeEffects.name: Echo
nativeEffects.description: Composites explicitly evaluated earlier frames on an Adjustment layer with configurable opacity decay and blending.

nativeEffects.name: Drop Shadow
nativeEffects.description: Adds a colored, offset, blurred shadow behind the layer.

nativeEffects.name: Time Offset
nativeEffects.description: Evaluates the layer at a deterministic time offset; on an Adjustment layer, time-shifts only the image fed into that layer.

nativeEffects.name: Posterize Time
nativeEffects.description: Evaluates the layer on a deterministic lower frame-rate clock; on an Adjustment layer, quantizes only the image fed into that layer.

nativeEffects.name: Time Displacement
nativeEffects.description: Displaces each pixel in time by the luminance of a displacement map, sampled across bounded time slices.

nativeEffects.name: CC Wide Time
nativeEffects.description: Blends forward and backward frame steps around the current time, averaged or accumulated.

nativeEffects.name: Time Difference
nativeEffects.description: Shows the difference between the layer now and the layer at a time offset, with contrast and alpha modes.
